Interface Item

All Known Implementing Classes:
Arrow, Axe, Bomb, Bow, Cookie, Curse, DespairShield, EnchantedDiamondSword, FireBall, Gant, Gold, KeyDoor, ManaStone, Massue, Mimicry, PoisonArrow, Shield, Sword
public interface Item
Represents an item that can be stored in the hero's backpack and used in combat. An item has a shape, a direction, durability, and stats. It may have passive or active effects, can be rotated, and may conduct mana.
